polls.averageMethod: The desk shows the simple unweighted mean of the valid-vote shares (lulaValid/bolsonaroValid) of the polls whose field work ended in the last 7 days before the as-of date, one poll per pollster (its latest). It is computed by build.py and is NOT a published aggregator average; no Brazilian aggregator with retrievable numbers was found (Poder360 publishes a database, not an average).
gaps: Release dates missing for several polls listed only in Poder360 roundups.
Wikipedia combines blank/null and undecided; those figures are in notes.
Field-date conflicts between sources are flagged in notes (Datafolha Oct 8 and Oct 15; PoderData Oct 22; Instituto França).
The TSE registration number is the authoritative id for each poll; some are missing.
